questions.question_english:
A Principal wants to ensure ‘Quality Assurance’
     in the school’s assessment procedures. This
     requires:
options_english: Conducting a single summative final examination at the end of the academic year exclusively to evaluate learning
Setting up proactive systems and rubrics to prevent assessment errors
Relying solely and completely on external board examiners and standardized testing agencies for student evaluation
Immediately firing or demoting classroom teachers whose enrolled students fail standardized terminal examinations
questions.explanation_english: Quality Assurance in educational assessment focuses on establishing proactive structural systems, standardized rubrics, and continuous process controls to prevent evaluation errors and ensure consistency. Unlike reactive quality control inspections, quality assurance systematically embeds clarity, fairness, reliability, and validity into assessment procedures prior to evaluation execution.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। शैक्षणिक मूल्यांकन में गुणवत्ता आश्वासन सक्रिय संरचनात्मक प्रणालियों, मानकीकृत मानदंडों, और निरंतर प्रक्रिया नियंत्रण की स्थापना पर केंद्रित है ताकि मूल्यांकन त्रुटियों को रोका जा सके और स्थिरता सुनिश्चित की जा सके। यह प्रतिक्रियाशील गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण निरीक्षणों के विपरीत है, गुणवत्ता आश्वासन मूल्यांकन प्रक्रियाओं में स्पष्टता, निष्पक्षता, विश्वसनीयता, और वैधता को प्रणालीबद्ध रूप से समाहित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Setting up proactive systems and rubrics to prevent assessment errors

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Quality Assurance in educational assessment focuses on establishing proactive structural systems, standardized rubrics, and continuous process controls to prevent evaluation errors and ensure consistency.

questions.question_english: In decision-making within educational management, 'bounded rationality' implies that:
options_english: Decision-makers are limited by values, habits, and incomplete information
School principals make operational decisions based on complete, limitless information
Objective rationality is completely absent in administrative decision-making processes
Group administrative decisions are always mathematically and logically optimal
questions.explanation_english: Bounded rationality, introduced by Herbert Simon, posits that human decision-makers cannot achieve pure objectivity or exhaustive rationality. In administrative contexts, managers face cognitive constraints, limited time, personal values, habitual biases, and incomplete information. Consequently, educational leaders evaluate options within these cognitive and contextual boundaries rather than searching endlessly for mathematically perfect theoretical solutions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सीमित तर्क, जिसे हर्बर्ट साइमोन ने प्रस्तुत किया, यह बताता है कि मानव निर्णय लेने वाले शुद्ध वस्तुनिष्ठता या व्यापक तर्क को प्राप्त नहीं कर सकते। प्रशासनिक संदर्भों में, प्रबंधकों को संज्ञानात्मक सीमाओं, सीमित समय, व्यक्तिगत मूल्यों, आदतों के पूर्वाग्रहों और अधूरी जानकारी का सामना करना पड़ता है। इसलिए, शैक्षिक नेता इन संज्ञानात्मक और संदर्भात्मक सीमाओं के भीतर विकल्पों का मूल्यांकन करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Decision-makers are limited by values, habits, and incomplete information

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Bounded rationality, introduced by Herbert Simon, posits that human decision-makers cannot achieve pure objectivity or exhaustive rationality.

In the context of quality assurance in schools,
     what does the PDCA cycle stand for?
options_english: Plan, Do, Check, Act
Process, Design, Coordinate, Assess
Plan, Direct, Control, Achieve
Prepare, Deploy, Correct, Analyze
questions.explanation_english: The PDCA cycle represents an iterative management method utilized for continuous quality improvement in institutional settings. Standing for Plan, Do, Check, and Act, the model guides administrators through establishing operational goals, implementing small-scale changes, evaluating performance metrics against initial expectations, and taking corrective actions to standardize successful systemic refinements across the school.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। PDCA चक्र एक आवर्ती प्रबंधन विधि का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जिसका उपयोग संस्थागत सेटिंग्स में निरंतर गुणवत्ता सुधार के लिए किया जाता है। योजना, करें, जांचें और कार्य करें के लिए खड़ा, यह मॉडल प्रशासकों को संचालनात्मक लक्ष्यों की स्थापना, छोटे पैमाने पर परिवर्तनों को लागू करने, प्रारंभिक अपेक्षाओं के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन मेट्रिक्स का मूल्यांकन करने और स्कूल में सफल प्रणालीगत सुधारों को मानकीकरण करने के लिए सुधारात्मक कार्रवाई करने में मार्गदर्शन करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Plan, Do, Check, Act
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The PDCA cycle represents an iterative management method utilized for continuous quality improvement in institutional settings.

questions.question_english: In Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, what does ‘Valence’ refer to?
options_english: The subjective probability estimation that personal effort will directly result in successful performance
The perceived likelihood estimation that successful performance will lead to a specific organizational outcome
The value or attractiveness an individual places on the expected outcome or reward
The total physical and mental energy expended by the employee during task performance
questions.explanation_english: Within Vroom’s Expectancy Theory framework, Valence signifies the personal value, psychological preference, or emotional attractiveness an individual assigns to a potential organizational outcome or reward. It measures whether a specific reward is desirable to the employee, ranging from positive to negative, thereby directly influencing the cognitive calculation of overall work motivation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। Vroom के अपेक्षा सिद्धांत के ढांचे में, Valence उस व्यक्तिगत मूल्य, मनोवैज्ञानिक प्राथमिकता, या भावनात्मक आकर्षण को दर्शाता है जो एक व्यक्ति संभावित संगठनात्मक परिणाम या पुरस्कार को देता है। यह मापता है कि क्या एक विशिष्ट पुरस्कार कर्मचारी के लिए वांछनीय है, जो सकारात्मक से नकारात्मक तक हो सकता है, इस प्रकार समग्र कार्य प्रेरणा की संज्ञानात्मक गणना को सीधे प्रभावित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) The value or attractiveness an individual places on the expected outcome or reward

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Valence signifies the personal value, psychological preference, or emotional attractiveness an individual assigns to a potential organizational outcome or reward.

questions.question_english: Which of the following describes ‘School Climate’ as opposed to ‘School Culture’?

The historical legacy, foundational traditions, and long-term overarching vision of the educational institution

questions.explanation_english: School climate refers to the immediate, perceived physical, social, and psychological environment experienced by teachers, students, and administrative staff daily. questions.question_english:
Evaluate the following statements regarding the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership Theory:
     I. It emphasizes the 'readiness' or maturity level of followers.
     II. It proposes four leadership styles: Telling, Selling, Participating, and Delegating.
     III. 'Telling' is most suitable for followers with high competence and high commitment.
     Which of the above statements is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: The Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership Theory emphasizes matching leadership behaviors—Telling, Selling, Participating, and Delegating—to follower readiness levels.
